name: HandDJ
tagline: A Snapchat lens that turns finger movements into electronic music.

awards: Best use of Snap Lens Studio

problem: Air-drumming at parties sounds great only in your head.
solution: Hand tracking maps finger positions to live instruments and sounds within a lens.
demo_moment: Team-described: wiggle fingers and hear the music change.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best use of Snap Lens Studio” among 212 submissions.
The demo video carries the idea.

lessons: A playful gesture-to-sound loop needs only a short video.
